kernel: fixed 2-period Si/SiO2 TMM, normal incidence, vacuum ambient/substrate
scope: numerical and synthesis spike, not a production kernel
notes: The float sin/cos implementation and fully unrolled matrix chain dominate resources.
192 DSPs for 2 periods leaves no room to scale to 32 layers on this part.
Next options: fixed-point CORDIC/LUT trig, shared/time-multiplexed multipliers, reduced unroll, a larger UltraScale+ part, or a GPU/surrogate path.
CPU remains the correct engine for interactive SME use; the FPGA case is batch throughput/power or embedded deployment.
